title: Quick Commerce & Dark Store Operations Lead (Zomato, Blinkit, Swiggy)
targetRole: Store Operations Associate / Dark Store Lead / Logistics Executive
description: Comprehensive interview & operational problem-solving curriculum for quick-commerce dark stores: 10-minute SLA order fulfillment, picker dispatch, rider batching, and inventory shrinkage control.

topics.summary: Master the core fulfillment engine of Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart.

problems.title: Picker Route Optimization during 8 PM Grocery Surge
problems.scenario: During the 8:00 PM peak, your dark store receives 140 orders/hour with only 6 pickers. Average picking time is 180 seconds per order. Calculate the backlog buildup rate and structure an emergency order-batching workflow to keep customer dispatch SLA below 6 minutes.
problems.solutionGuidance: Apply 2-tier batching: Group orders sharing cold-storage aisles. Reassign 2 packing staff to pre-bag high-frequency SKUs (milk, bread, eggs). This reduces average picking cycle from 180s to 110s, clearing 32 additional orders/hour.
problems.keyTakeaway: In quick commerce interviews, always prioritize aisle cluster batching over simple FIFO queue processing.

problems.title: Rider Idle Time vs Customer Delivery Time Optimization
problems.scenario: In an urban sector, 18 delivery partners are waiting outside a partner restaurant hub with an average wait time of 14 minutes. How would you calibrate delivery radius and restaurant preparation triggers to bring rider idle wait times under 5 minutes without causing cold food deliveries?
problems.solutionGuidance: Shift from static dispatch (calling rider on order acceptance) to dynamic kitchen hand-off triggers (dispatching rider when kitchen marks "Ready in 4 mins"). Reallocate waiting riders to nearby fast-food nodes.
problems.keyTakeaway: Demonstrates deep understanding of Kitchen Prep Time (KPT) calibration.

problems.title: Perishable Produce Shrinkage & Daily Expiry Mitigation
problems.scenario: Hyperpure b2b supply reports a 4.8% waste shrink on fresh green vegetables delivered to restaurant partners. Design a 3-tier inspection and discount-bundling protocol for day+1 stock that reduces net inventory loss below 1.5%.
problems.solutionGuidance: Institute dynamic price reductions for early-morning bulk kitchen buyers, introduce vacuum-sealed grading at harvest drop-off, and channel residual grade-B items to high-consumption cloud kitchen clients.
problems.keyTakeaway: Crucial for Hyperpure and Blinkit supply chain executive roles.

topics.topicTitle: Customer Escalations, District Events & Partner Quality Assurance
topics.summary: Handling merchant disputes, live event tickets (District by Zomato), and rider SLAs.

problems.title: Monsoon Spike & Surge Delivery Radius Throttling
problems.scenario: Heavy downpour causes 40% of active riders to go offline while incoming food orders surge by 85%. Formulate an automated dispatch throttling criteria to prevent extreme 90-minute delivery delays and brand backlash.
problems.solutionGuidance: Activate monsoon geofencing: Shrink customer delivery radius from 7km to 2.8km around cluster kitchens. Pause acceptances for low-margin single item carts. Introduce high-priority wet weather rider incentive bonuses.
problems.keyTakeaway: Direct interview question for Zomato City Operations Associates.

problems.title: Live Event Ticketing & Crowd Turnstile Flow Control
problems.scenario: District is managing a 12,000 attendee concert in Bengaluru. Turnstiles at Gate 2 experience a scanner network lag of 12 seconds per barcode. How do you prevent crowd stampede risks and maintain verified admissions?
problems.solutionGuidance: Switch entry scanners to offline cryptographic cached token verification. Deploy 4 manual paper backup wristband lanes for attendees with valid booking SMS/QR receipts.
problems.keyTakeaway: Highlights rapid crisis mitigation in experiential event operations.

problems.title: Negotiating Exclusive Product Launch Terms with FMCG Brands
problems.scenario: An artisan beverage brand wants prominent hero banner placement on Blinkit for their new cold-brew coffee. They offer a 16% margin against your category standard of 24%. Formulate a performance-linked margin step-up contract.
problems.solutionGuidance: Offer 18% base margin for week 1 with mandatory co-funded sampling coupons. If daily orders exceed 250 units, margin steps up to 22%. Include penalty SLA for stockout hours.
problems.keyTakeaway: Essential for Category Manager and Brand Alliance interviews.

problems.title: Set Matrix Zeroes In-Place
problems.scenario: Given an m x n integer matrix, if an element is 0, set its entire row and column to 0. Do it in-place using O(1) extra space.
problems.solutionGuidance: Use first row and column as flag indicators, maintaining a separate variable for col0 state.

problems.title: Pascal Triangle Row Generation
problems.scenario: Generate the Nth row of Pascals Triangle in O(N) time without calculating previous rows.
problems.solutionGuidance: Calculate each element using the combination relation: element = element * (row - col) / col.
